name: Five Mushrooms, New Place
jem_summary: Grow five matching mushrooms on a Mungus and trigger its native biome conversion in a permitted plot.

pages.title: Five Mushrooms, New Place
pages.text: Grow five matching mushrooms on a Mungus and trigger its native biome conversion in a permitted plot.

pages.title: Five Mushrooms, New Place
pages.text: A prepared Mungus changes terrain through its native ability.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Its beam grows mushrooms and matching food forms a colony. Death with five mushrooms converts nearby biome; poisonous potato reverses it. Spores also breed Mungi and transform other creatures.
